name: sdlc
description: ai-sdlc holds an AI coding agent, and the people directing it, to what was written down. Every change is planned before any code exists, challenged by a reader that never saw it written, approved by a person against the exact text, and proved from recorded evidence. A pull-request check refuses anything missing a link. The solution's rules and decisions live in the repository beside its code and carry from one cycle to the next, so every stage of every change is read against everything settled before it. Whatever contradicts them is brought into the open, for the person and the model alike, rather than slipping through.
